summary: Iter5 testing complete — token-protected admin endpoints + APScheduler daily roundup + admin dashboard UI fully verified. 14/14 backend tests pass; all 9 admin FE flows pass + landing CTA still public/working.
critical_code_review_comments: require_admin dependency in server.py is clean — returns 503 if ADMIN_TOKEN unset (fail-fast) and 401 with consistent detail 'Invalid or missing admin token' for missing/wrong header. Token comparison strips whitespace on both sides — no issues.
POST /api/leads correctly remains public (no Depends(require_admin)) — CTA form submission still returns 201; backward compatible.

AsyncIOScheduler is registered in @app.on_event('startup') with replace_existing=True and id='daily_lead_roundup' — confirmed log line 'Scheduler started — daily lead roundup at 09:00 UTC.' on every backend boot. Shutdown handler guards scheduler.running before .shutdown(), avoiding errors on cold-shutdown.

roundup.py uses ISO-string range query on created_at which is correct because all dates are stored as ISO-8601 (sortable). Fallback path returns {status:'skipped', leads:N} when RESEND_API_KEY/LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL absent — handled gracefully in FE toast.
AdminPage.jsx: token persisted to localStorage 'ss_admin_token' on submit; load() runs in effect after authed=true; on 401 it auto-logs out + toast.error('Invalid admin token'). Clean UX.
Minor: AdminPage CSV export computes the blob client-side from already-fetched leads (capped at limit=200) — fine for now, but at >200 leads admin would need server-side CSV. Not blocking.
Minor: roundup.py uses string comparison for created_at; works because format is consistent ISO-8601 with timezone. Acceptable.

Minor: ADMIN_TOKEN is currently a 32-char alphanumeric — adequate entropy, but consider documenting rotation procedure since token is displayed plaintext in logs if mis-typed (auto-redaction not implemented).
